assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original terrain boundary atlas for a 2D side-scrolling dark fantasy game. 1536x1024 RGBA, three separate tall cliff strips in three columns. These are solid geological cross-sections, NOT isolated pillars or mountains in a landscape.
Left strip: damp blue-grey fractured cave limestone with a little moss, fine roots, chipped ledges and dark mineral seams. Middle strip: layered burnt basalt, earthy rusty striations, sparse dead roots, no lava glow. Right strip: weathered indigo-grey mountain shale with scattered old stonework partly embedded in the natural rock.
Each strip fills the LEFT side of its own 512px-wide cell as nearly black SOLID rock, transitioning toward detailed illuminated craggy stone on its RIGHT edge. The RIGHT silhouette is irregular with small natural protrusions, staying within x=340..465 of each cell. Transparent empty margin only to the right of each silhouette. The leftmost 80px in each cell is opaque near-black rock, not transparent. Each cliff strip extends continuously all the way from top to bottom, suitable for overlapping vertically without distinct pedestal, top peak or ground plane. Orthographic side elevation, no perspective, no sky. Detailed matte painterly 2D textures; muted cool light from the open right side, deep dark interiors. Surface detail must read at gameplay scale. No words, outlines, bright cyan geometric shapes, characters, doors, grid or watermark.
